# js-yaml

`js-yaml.mjs` is the unmodified ES module distribution of js-yaml **4.1.1**,
from <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/js-yaml@4.1.1/dist/js-yaml.mjs>.
Its MIT license is in `js-yaml.LICENSE`.

Upstream: <https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml/tree/4.1.1>.
The WASM editor uses it only for the YAML data pane; PHP identifies the format first.
